title: Neil Armstrong's 1975 Tayos cave expedition

plain: After walking on the moon in 1969, the astronaut Neil Armstrong is said to have gone to the Tayos cave in Ecuador, at the edge of the Amazon, which was rumoured to hold ancient alien metal objects and a kind of hidden library. Michels tells this himself in several episodes, usually putting it in 1975 (once in 1976), saying Armstrong brought a film crew from the BBC, the British broadcaster, and linking the cave to Erich von Däniken, a writer of ancient-alien theories, and his book Chariots of the Gods. Michels finds it striking that the first man on the moon made this his next trip.
